messages: rachel_cs: Heads-up — Maplespring cutover in 6h. Two unique blockers: their audit log bucket is rejecting our CloudTrail delivery (403) and the customer reports our privdeploy-assume role gets AssumeRole but then PutObject errors due to retention/LegalHold on the bucket. Need quick triage and mitigation plan. :warning: vijay_neteng: 403 for PutObject usually means either bucket policy or Object Lock mode/RetainUntilDate preventing writes with the given headers. Do we have the exact S3 error? Also confirm whether CloudTrail is delivering with SSE-KMS and if the KMS key matches the bucket policy. lee_kms: If CloudTrail uses SSE-KMS, then both the KMS key policy and the bucket policy must allow the CloudTrail service principal and the putter principal. If they're using object lock with compliance mode, that shouldn't block PutObject, but retention settings could cause different errors depending on write parameters. Please paste the S3 error. rachel_cs: They pasted: "AccessDeniedAccess Denied" and CloudTrail shows `PutObject` 403 for `arn:aws:sts::556677889900:assumed-role/maple-privdeploy-role`. They also attached a screenshot showing their bucket has "Retention: Enabled (Governance)", not Compliance. vijay_neteng: Governance retention can be bypassed by principals with the s3:BypassGovernanceRetention permission. Does our role have that? Typically we avoid granting that. Alternative: have them create a short-lived delivery prefix (e.g., logs/redwood/temp/) that is not under retention, or add a resource-based statement to the bucket policy allowing our principal to PutObject to that prefix. carol_sec: Two security notes: (1) granting s3:BypassGovernanceRetention is high-risk; avoid unless necessary. (2) If we ask them to loosen bucket policy, ensure it's scoped to the CloudTrail delivery principal or our exact assumed role ARN and path. For renewals: repeated manual workarounds on audit storage is a signal — add to renewal risk register: "Customer-managed audit policies require operator intervention >1x/month". lee_kms: Also check KMS key grants. If CloudTrail delivery uses SSE-KMS, you'll see a KMS Encrypt attempt by `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` or by the PutObject principal. We need the key policy to allow `kms:Encrypt` from both `cloudtrail.amazonaws.com` and the delivery role. If not, create a limited grant for the `cloudtrail` service principal and the delivery role with an EncryptionContext constraint (e.g., `aws:cloudtrail:arn`). rachel_cs: Proposed short-term mitigation options (please react with preference): 1) Customer creates a temporary prefix without retention and updates trail to deliver there (fast, low-risk). 2) Customer adds a very-scoped bucket policy allowing our assumed role on `arn:aws:s3:::maple-audit/logs/redwood/*` (scoped, needs review). 3) We request s3:BypassGovernanceRetention for our role and implement TTL on the role via session tags (highest risk). ops-bot: Reminder — Maplespring onboarding ticket #MP-707 closes in 8 hours. Update ticket with chosen mitigation. vijay_neteng: I prefer option 1. I'll draft the CLI steps for the customer to create a new prefix and update CloudTrail destination: \n```sh\naws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket maple-audit --lifecycle-configuration file://lifecycle.json\n# OR create prefix and update trail\naws cloudtrail update-trail --name maple-trail --s3-prefix \"redwood/temp\"\n```\n lee_kms: I'll prepare the minimal `aws kms create-grant` snippet for the case we need a grant for the delivery role and set `Constraints.EncryptionContextSubset` to include `cloudtrail=true` so it's narrow. carol_sec: I'll add the renewal-risk blurb to MP-707: "If audit storage policies repeatedly require operator-scoped exceptions, recommend a managed logging solution or contract amendment for managed support." rachel_cs: Plan: Vijay posts the update to the customer with option 1 steps; if customer can't change prefix within 2 hours we escalate to option 2 and I will schedule a 10-min bridge. Everyone ack? vijay_neteng: Ack. Drafting message now. lee_kms: Ack. I'll be on the bridge if we need to create a short-lived grant. carol_sec: Ack. Adding retention / legal-hold checklist to our onboarding runbook for future customers. rachel_cs: Thanks all — I'll update MP-707 and ping if we need the bridge. :white_check_mark:
